segment.ser_dominance_mean.name: ser_dominance_mean
segment.ser_dominance_mean.definition: Mean predicted dominance (listeners' 'sounds assured / in control'). Compared with the speaker's own other answers (Stage 2 self-delta) for the composure class; the raw value partly describes the voice. [Stage 5: audeering dimensional SER (MSP-Podcast), 4-s windows, 2-s hop, windows with >= 50% speech.]

segment.ser_arousal_mean.name: ser_arousal_mean
segment.ser_arousal_mean.definition: Mean predicted arousal (activation / energy; high + raised pitch = tension). [Stage 5: audeering dimensional SER (MSP-Podcast), 4-s windows, 2-s hop, windows with >= 50% speech.]

segment.ser_valence_mean.name: ser_valence_mean
segment.ser_valence_mean.definition: Mean predicted valence (positivity). No audio category; diagnostic. [Stage 5: audeering dimensional SER (MSP-Podcast), 4-s windows, 2-s hop, windows with >= 50% speech.]

segment.ser_n_windows.name: ser_n_windows
segment.ser_n_windows.definition: Windows with >= 50% speech. [Stage 5: audeering dimensional SER (MSP-Podcast), 4-s windows, 2-s hop, windows with >= 50% speech.]

segment.ser_dominance_drop_sd.name: ser_dominance_drop_sd
segment.ser_dominance_drop_sd.definition: Largest fall of the smoothed (3-window) speaker-relative dominance curve within the answer. [Stage 5: audeering dimensional SER (MSP-Podcast), 4-s windows, 2-s hop, windows with >= 50% speech.]

segment.ser_tension_run_s.name: ser_tension_run_s
segment.ser_tension_run_s.definition: Longest run of consecutive windows with arousal z > 1.0 AND window pitch z > 1.0 (both vs the speaker's other recordings). [Stage 5: audeering dimensional SER (MSP-Podcast), 4-s windows, 2-s hop, windows with >= 50% speech.]
